# CLUSTER_EDGE

Where a cluster's gateway is dialled from the host running the lab.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `edge`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.edge`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
